# LibriSpeech dev-clean speech fixture

`1272-128104-0000` is a 5.855 s excerpt from Oscar Wilde’s *Reviews*, read
by John Rose for LibriVox. The source is the [LibriSpeech ASR corpus] by
Vassil Panayotov, Guoguo Chen, Daniel Povey and Sanjeev Khudanpur, licensed
under [CC BY 4.0].

The clip comes from `LibriSpeech/dev-clean/1272/128104/1272-128104-0000.flac`
in OpenSLR's `dev-clean.tar.gz`. It was losslessly converted to mono 16 kHz
PCM16 WAV for the windowed speech E2E reader. The sibling `.txt` contains the
official transcript from `1272-128104.trans.txt`, with the utterance ID removed.

[LibriSpeech ASR corpus]: https://www.openslr.org/12/
[CC BY 4.0]: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
